Priya: Heads-up — weve had multiple support reports where the python SDK surfaces a generic Exception and users can't tell auth vs rate-limit.
Ethan: example? paste one.
Priya: from a repro: `Exception: Request failed (status=401)` — nothing else. They retried instead of refreshing tokens.
Noah: rust-sdk solved this with a TypedError enum (Unauthorized/RateLimit/Server) + fields. very ergonomic for service code.
Zara: i propose a minimal ApiError shape exposed by all SDKs: `http_status` (int), `error_kind` (string enum), `retryable` (bool), optional `retry_after` (int seconds), plus `details` (string). Also preserve the original exception in `__cause__` for compatibility.
Priya: important for DX: update quickstart samples to show `except ApiError as e:` instead of catching generic Exception. current quickstart just prints the error and exits.
Ethan: agree. also add a canonical mapping in SDK-spec so every language maps codes consistently: 401->Unauthorized, 403->Forbidden, 404->NotFound, 409->Conflict, 429->RateLimit, 500-599->ServerError.
Noah: nuance: retryability depends on idempotency. a POST may be non-retryable even for 5xx. suggest helper `should_retry(method)` on ApiError that checks method + flags.
Zara: include `retry_after` parsed from `Retry-After` header and a small helper `backoff_until()` sample in docs.
Priya: sample snippet for python quickstart we should land:
```
try:
    client.create_resource(...)
except ApiError as e:
    if e.retryable and e.should_retry('POST'):
        exponential_backoff()
    elif e.error_kind == 'Unauthorized':
        refresh_tokens()
    else:
        raise
```
Ethan: tests: unit tests for the mapping table and integration test that `e.__cause__` is a `requests.HTTPError` when using requests transport.
Noah: compatibility note: some infra code catches `requests.HTTPError`. setting `__cause__` via `raise ApiError(...) from original_exc` should keep behavior without tight coupling.
Zara: docs: add migration bullet: "If you previously caught Exception, update to catch ApiError and inspect `error_kind`/`retryable`." and cross-language examples.
ci-bot: ci: py-sdk/mapping_tests.py passed at 2024-11-12T08:41:12Z
Priya: next steps: (1) SDK-spec PR with mapping table, (2) py-sdk PR implementing ApiError + tests + MIGRATION.md, (3) update quickstart samples and docs, (4) add pre-commit lint to check `raise from` when wrapping.
Ethan: i'll review the spec PR. also add a changelog entry calling out small surface change (new attributes only). minimal break risk.
Noah: i'll add idempotency tests and the integration test preserving `__cause__`.
Zara: i'll update the quickstart sample and the sample video captions.
Priya: PR draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/py-sdk/pull/220 (draft)
Ethan: will review tomorrow morning. thanks Priya — this should reduce onboarding tickets significantly.
